title: Prepare portfolio for Firebase Hosting
summary: Configured Next.js static export, Firebase Hosting and a GitHub Actions deployment workflow for the existing portfolio.
outcome: The production build generated the homepage and seven project pages. Firebase Hosting emulator checks passed for direct paths, trailing-slash redirects, navigation payloads, sitemap, robots and 404. The workflow passed actionlint. No Firebase release had been published at capture time.
decisions: Serve the generated HTML files using Firebase Hosting on Spark, with the Firebase project host as the production metadata origin until a custom domain is verified.
Build pull requests without deployment credentials and reserve live deployments for the main branch.
blockers: Direct Chrome access and an authorized Firebase project connection were not available at capture time.
next_actions: Connect the Firebase project to the GitHub workflow, deploy a preview, verify the bilingual flows and contact links, then verify the live web.app release.
evidence: npm run build and Firebase Hosting emulator HTTP checks
